# Regaarder · 23:29–25:29 portraits and marks

Each file is a standalone asset. Keep founder photographs independent of the ornate frame. The source portraits are preserved as retrieved.

| File | Source and use |
|---|---|
| adi-original.jpg | adidas Archive via adidas Group. Founder wall. [Source](https://www.adidas-group.com/en/magazine/innovation/the-history-of-adidas-a-background-of-collaboration-and-innovation) |
| rudolf-original.jpg | PUMA Archive via Deutsche Biographie. Founder wall. [Source](https://www.deutsche-biographie.de/dbo027444-5.html) |
| robert-louis-dreyfus-adidas.png | adidas Group history. Source portrait is 444 × 430, with a tighter crop than the editable hero layer. [Source](https://www.adidas-group.com/en/about/history) |
| jochen-zeitz-2021.jpg | Harley-Davidson, 2021, unmodified 3771 × 4714 photo. Later likeness for the Puma segment. [Source](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Jochen_Zeitz_HD_Photo_2021.jpg) · [CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/) |
| adidas-trefoil.svg | Existing Regaarder vector sourced from Wikimedia Commons. [Source](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Adidas_trefoil_logo.svg) |
| puma.svg | Existing Regaarder source vector. [Source](https://www.svgrepo.com/svg/303336/puma-logo) |
| nike-wordmark.svg | Nike wordmark from Wikimedia Commons. [Source](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Nike_wordmark.svg) |
| adidas-yeezy.png | 2021 × 617 wordmark image from Wikimedia Commons. [Source](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Adidas_Yeezy_Logo.png) |

The separately generated cinematic hero portraits are reconstructions derived from the listed likeness sources. Keep those edits distinct from the source photos. The Jochen Zeitz reconstruction is an adaptation of the Harley-Davidson photo under CC BY-SA 3.0.
